home_tagline: A privacy-first learning environment for teaching AI and Teknologiforståelse.
stack_check_intro: This scratch route renders shadcn-svelte components against the clean-slate theme variables. Every string here comes from a Paraglide message — no literals in components.
stack_check_dialog_description: If the radius, colours, fonts and open animation match the clean-slate theme, the UnoCSS and shadcn-svelte pairing is wired correctly.
stack_check_font_mono: JetBrains Mono renders the mono stack.
login_intro: Enter the access code from your card.
login_failed: That code did not work. Check it and try again.
login_help: Lost your card? Ask your teacher for a new code.
chat_empty_body: Write a message below to begin. Everything you write stays in your own account.
chat_editing_notice: Editing an earlier message. Sending creates a new branch.
chat_notice_interrupted: This answer was cut short. Ask again to continue.
chat_notice_error: The assistant is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
chat_turn_in_flight: Wait for the current answer to finish, or stop it first.
classroom_closed_locked: Your teacher has locked the classroom.
classroom_closed_outside: There is no lesson right now.
classroom_no_next_opening: Your teacher will open it again.
classroom_closed_meanwhile: Your conversations are still here when the classroom opens.
chat_refusal_classroom_locked: Your teacher has locked the classroom. You cannot send messages right now.
chat_refusal_outside_schedule: The classroom is closed. You can write again during the next lesson.
chat_refusal_model_not_allowed: This model is not available in your class. Ask your teacher.
chat_refusal_student_allowance_exhausted: You have used today's allowance. It starts again tomorrow.
chat_refusal_classroom_cap_exhausted: Your class has used today's shared allowance. It starts again tomorrow.
chat_refusal_unavailable: You cannot send a message right now. Ask your teacher.
chat_notice_budget: This answer stopped early to stay inside today's limits.
educator_login_intro: Sign in with the account from your deployment configuration.
educator_login_failed: That username and password did not work.
educator_no_classrooms: No classrooms yet. Create one to begin.
educator_schedule_empty: No lessons scheduled. Add one below.
educator_alias_dpa_label: Covered by a data processing agreement
educator_alias_input_price_label: Input price, USD per million tokens
educator_alias_output_price_label: Output price, USD per million tokens
educator_alias_utility_label: Use for internal work such as titles
educator_allowlist_empty: No models yet. Add one under Models first.
educator_no_dpa_confirm_title: This model has no data processing agreement
educator_no_dpa_confirm_body: Prompts and attachments from this class will reach a provider that has not signed a data processing agreement. In a school, what pupils write — and images all the more — is personal data, however pseudonymous the account. You are making this choice for this class.
educator_classroom_daily_label: Tokens for the class per day
educator_classroom_instructions_help: Added to every conversation in this class. Pupils never see it.
educator_session_policy_label: How long pupils stay signed in
educator_tools_intro: Servers are defined in the configuration file on disk. The panel switches them on and chooses which of their tools a class may use.
educator_tool_sensitive_help: In standard mode a tool marked this way asks the pupil before it runs.
educator_permission_standard: Ask only for tools marked “ask first”
educator_permission_open_warning: Every enabled tool will run without asking the pupil first, including tools you marked “ask first”.
educator_tool_allowlist_empty: No tools are configured yet. Add a server in the configuration file, then switch its tools on under Tools.
educator_skills_intro: A skill is a name, one line of description, and a set of instructions the model reads when it needs them. Uploaded and imported text arrives switched off.
educator_skill_upload_help: A Markdown or text file. It arrives switched off until you enable it.
educator_skill_import_unavailable: The registry could not be reached. Upload the skill as a file instead.
educator_skill_upload_failed: That file could not be read as a skill.
educator_student_skills_empty: No pupil has written a skill yet.
chat_permission_declined_notice: You said no. The answer continues without it.
chat_attachment_refusal_attachments_disa: Attachments are switched off in this class.
chat_attachment_refusal_type_not_allowed: That kind of file cannot be attached here.
chat_attachment_refusal_too_many: That is one file too many.
chat_attachment_refusal_image_input_not_: This model cannot look at pictures. Try a text file, or ask your teacher for another model.
chat_attachment_refusal_unavailable: That file could not be attached.
chat_image_refusal_no_generation_alias: Making pictures is not switched on in this class.
chat_image_refusal_unavailable: Pictures cannot be made right now. Try again in a moment.
student_skills_intro: A skill tells the assistant how you want it to work. Write one, try it, and change it.
student_skills_empty: You have not written a skill yet.
student_skill_pending_notice: Your teacher needs to approve this before it works.
student_skill_rejected_notice: Your teacher did not approve this one.
student_skills_disabled_notice: Writing skills is switched off in this class.
